name: Block, Inc.
blurb: Block, Inc. (formerly Square) is a technology company that provides an integrated ecosystem of commerce and financial services. Its brands include Square (point-of-sale and payment processing for sellers), Cash App (peer-to-peer payments and financial tools), Afterpay (buy now, pay later), and TIDAL (music streaming). The company serves millions of merchants and individual users globally, competing with traditional financial institutions and fintech peers.
recent: On January 9, 2025, Block announced its ticker symbol would change from SQ to XYZ, effective January 21, 2025, on the NYSE. The change aligns with the company's rebranding to Block and its multi-brand ecosystem. No other major news or earnings events were reported in the past 30 days.
